en.p: A function $f(x)$ defined on the set of all real numbers satisfies the following conditions.

box: $f(x)=-x^{2}+4x$ for $0\le x<4$, and $f(x+4)=f(x)$ for every real number $x$.

en.p: When all nonnegative real roots of the equation $f\big(f(x)\big)=f(x)$ are listed in increasing order, let $a_n$ be the $n$th number. The following is the process of finding the value of $a_{20}+a_{21}+a_{22}$.

box: Since all real roots of the equation $f(x)=x$ are $0$ and $3$, finding the real roots of $f\big(f(x)\big)=f(x)$ is the same as finding the real roots of $f(x)\times\big(f(x)-3\big)=0$.
For $0\le x<4$, all real roots of $f(x)\times\big(f(x)-3\big)=0$ are $0$, $\boxed{\ (\text{A})\ }$, $3$, so

Also, since $f(x+4)=f(x)$ for every real number $x$, the three sequences $\{a_{3n-2}\}$, $\{a_{3n-1}\}$, $\{a_{3n}\}$ are arithmetic sequences with first terms $0$, $\boxed{\ (\text{A})\ }$, $3$, respectively, and common difference $\boxed{\ (\text{B})\ }$ for all three.

en.p: Let $p$, $q$, $r$ be the numbers that fit (A), (B), (C) above, respectively. Find the value of $p+q+r$. [4 points]
